decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board early on, while Ephemerate and Flickerwisp provide extra value by blinking key creatures. Aether Vial allows for cheating creatures into play at instant speed. The deck aims to tax your opponent's resources with cards like White Orchid Phantom and Recruiter of the Guard, while finishing the game quickly with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones.

Utilizing a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures, this Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently generating card advantage. The deck also takes advantage of the synergy between cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Nethergoyf to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the game. With the versatility of flexible mana base and the power of cards like Urza's Saga, this deck is designed to adapt to various situations and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of disruption and threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies combined with the ability to blink creatures for added value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects and disrupt your opponent's board. Aether Vial helps you cheat creatures into play at instant speed, while cards like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition offer removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive plays, keeping the pressure on while maintaining a versatile board presence.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's resources while utilizing efficient removal spells and powerful creatures to maintain board presence. The deck includes a mix of counter spells, hand disruption, removal, and card draw to control the pace of the game. The inclusion of creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog provide additional threats while also providing utility in disrupting the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's strategy, disrupt their plans, and eventually outvalue them with its powerful spells and creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Underworld Breach to quickly and efficiently mill through the deck with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal help with ramping and card advantage, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card draw. The goal is to set up the combo pieces and use them to win the game in a single turn, utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble and Thassa's Oracle to secure victory. The deck also includes disruption elements like Lightning Bolt and Swan Song to control the board and protect the combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with specific abilities to generate value and create a combo chain. It uses tools like Birthing Ritual and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces, such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The creatures in the deck, like Cauldron Familiar and Samwise Gamgee, work together synergistically to create powerful board states and overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to utilize its toolbox of creatures to control the game and eventually win through a powerful combo or overwhelming board presence.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures to control the board and ramp up to powerful threats quickly. It combines control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command with ramp spells like Sowing Mycospawn and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate into big threats like World Breaker and Emrakul, the Promised End. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and recursion for key artifacts, while Nulldrifter allows for card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt opponents while overwhelming them with powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and cantrips, in order to cast a large number of spells in one turn and finish off the opponent with a massive Grapeshot. The deck also includes cards that allow for card advantage, graveyard recursion, and the ability to dig for combo pieces. The key strategy is to set up a chain of spells that will lead to a lethal Grapeshot, while managing resources effectively and staying ahead in tempo to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. With a wide array of instant-speed spells, including powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Spell Snare, the goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and establishing board presence. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Mystic Gate and Flooded Strand to ensure consistent mana production and flexibility in casting spells.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the board through a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. The deck aims to protect its key threats, like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell. The deck also includes ways to draw cards efficiently, like Lórien Revealed and Geier Reach Sanitarium, to ensure it can keep up with the opponent's threats and maintain control of the game until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that have blink effects to repeatedly exile and return creatures, generating value and disrupting the opponent's strategy. It includes both aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and control elements like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize. The deck aims to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their game plan through blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck's spells.

This deck focuses on aggressively controlling the board by repeatedly flickering creatures using Ephemerate and Aether Vial. By blinking creatures with powerful abilities like Skyclave Apparition and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a steady stream of threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Solitude and Fatal Push for removal, as well as Recruiter of the Guard to tutor for key creatures. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its versatile and unpredictable gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously loop cards from the graveyard, along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to generate mana and card advantage. The combo pieces like Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble are crucial for achieving a win condition. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card selection and digging for combo pieces. Mox Amber and Urza's Saga provide additional mana ramp. The deck also includes disruption elements like Unholy Heat, Soul-Guide Lantern, and Pithing Needle to disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game through a powerful sequence of plays.

This deck relies on using a combination of cards that manipulate spell costs and allow for quick mana generation to repeatedly activate Goblin Charbelcher's ability to deal damage directly to the opponent. By controlling the board with counterspells and disruption spells, the deck aims to prevent the opponent from interfering with its combo. The deck also includes cards that allow for card draw, tutoring, and additional protection for key combo pieces, ensuring consistency and resilience against disruption. Ultimately, the goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and execute the win condition before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to maintain board control and card advantage while gradually building up threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. By managing the opponent's resources and responding to threats efficiently, the Dimir Control deck seeks to outmaneuver the opponent and secure a victory through attrition and strategic play.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and brought into play at the right time to create powerful combos. It utilizes a mix of sacrifice outlets, recursion, and tutoring effects to find and utilize key pieces like Cauldron Familiar, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Green Sun's Zenith. By constantly recurring and sacrificing creatures, the deck aims to generate value and outvalue the opponent while also disrupting their game plan. The deck aims to be versatile and adaptable to different situations through its toolbox of creatures and combo pieces.
